title: The promo video, second draft — the bubble's shape

steps.path: Every line the mascot says, all through the film
steps.headline: Which shape should the frosted bubble have?
steps.notice: All three fix what you flagged: the box and its tail are now drawn as one piece, so the outline runs unbroken around both, and the outline is 2.5 px in the theme's colour instead of a 1 px hairline. Light theme on top, dark below.
steps.risk: The tails reach a little further toward the mascot than before, so a bubble sits about 4 px closer to its head.

variants.label: Comic wedge
variants.summary: Squarer corners and a straight, pointed tail — the classic comic-strip speech bubble.

variants.label: Curled tail
variants.summary: A pill with a tail that sweeps down toward the mouth in a curve — softer and more playful. My pick.

variants.label: Rounded nub
variants.summary: A round box with a short, rounded bump for a tail — the quietest of the three, closest to a chat app.
